notes.title: Patch Update for v.1.5.57
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We’ve got another patch update with a handful of bug fixes to improve the overall game performance:

- Fixed game tie rules. Tie breaks are awarded to the player that has more influence in Strategic Sea Lanes OR to whatever player is holding the Romanian Autonomy card at the end of the game
- Fixed the Middle East scoring card to now appear as playable in game
- Fixed the Strategic Sea Lanes display issue to be correctly calculated and recognized in final scoring
- Fixed Albano-Stalinist Economics to recognize Egypt as an African region 
- Fixed AI to not always place CENTOM in Saudi Arabia even when it’s USSR controlled 
- Fixed Water Wars to remove influence from the country that has MORE influence rather then LESS influence as stated in the cards description 
- Fixed description text spacing for Kenya Joins Rapid Deployment Force 
- Fixed description text spacing for The Events of ’86
- Fixed Our Man In Tehran to read as a Mid War card 

If you experience any issues you can submit them to https://steamcommunity.com/app/1276130/discussions/3/ OR you can email was us at support@playdekgames.com and we'll assist you from there. Thanks!

Playdek

notes.title: Patch Update for v.1.4.51
notes.content:
Hey players! 

This update covers fixes and improvements to various bugs reported since release: 

- Fixed Space Race reward at first space. 
- Fixed Mr. Nyet placing influence in Egypt. 
- Fixed Albano-Stalinist Economics ops display.
- Fixed Afghanistan Invaded to prevent eventing of the Presidential Directive 30 card.
- Fixed Water Wars to just remove influence and not replace it.
- Fixed Turn Counter to display accurately.
- Added in-game timer to online games.
- Added ops placement location to the logs.
- Fixed Peace Corps rules to prevent US from placing influence wherever it wants. 
- Fixed Marxist Leninist Parties Vanguard to be able to move influence.
- Fixed The Victorious Leader to correct influence placement. 
- Fixed Anti-Zionist Committee to allow for correct Realignment rolls.


If you experience any issues you can submit them to https://steamcommunity.com/app/1276130/discussions/3/ OR you can email was us at support@playdekgames.com and we'll assist you from there. Thanks!
